The first stable build of this BasePilot for the October 2026 Clash of Clans UI on Google Play Games. It replaces the 1.3.0 betas.

**Builder Base**
- One strategy whatever the army (*Your army (auto)* on the Run page): each card on the bar is read as its troop, and each troop plays its role. Tanks open the way, flankers clear the outer buildings on both sides, Bombers and the support follow, Baby Dragons land apart.
- Before each stage the bot looks at the base and attacks it from one of its best sides, right next to its buildings, not always the same one.
- An army with Power P.E.K.K.As goes for the Multi Mortar: the Bomber lands first and opens the walls with its Bouncing Bomb, the P.E.K.K.As go in behind it, the machine follows.
- Abilities go at the right moment, one at a time: once the troop is engaged and while its card is ready; the machine's every 20 s.
- A battle is never surrendered. In the second stage, the troops that survived the first are deployed again with the reinforcements, and the last minute of each stage plays at 4x.
- The elixir cart is collected when full and its window closed; nothing else is tapped in the village.
- The live status on the Run page follows Builder Base runs too (storages and loot).

**Home Village**
- **Minimum loot** is back on the Run page: a base holding less is skipped with Next, on 16:10 windows too. Settings caps the skips per raid.
- The resource numbers of the HUD are read by a small OCR model (bundled): no more dropped digits on small windows.
- Auto upgrade starts the priciest affordable upgrade first, whatever its resource; running upgrades no longer show a cost; the Build panel is closed by its X.
- "Connection lost": Try again is tapped on the real dialog.
- The run duration shows its minutes again.

First run: Clash of Clans open in Google Play Games, the village you want selected on the Run page, then **Start** and watch the Logs page for a few raids. For the Home Village, set **Auto upgrade** to **Dry run** first and switch to **Maxer** once its picks look right.

16:9 windows are checked on rebuilt screenshots only. If something goes wrong, send the log (Logs page) and the `debug` folder from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\BasePilot`.

Download **BasePilot.exe** (Tesseract and the OCR model are bundled); **BasePilot.exe.sha256** has its checksum. The exe is not signed, so SmartScreen warns: More info, then Run anyway. Botting breaks Supercell's terms of service and can get an account banned.
